sourceGallery.stagingNote: Source bytes were downloaded only for review; canonical private staging was not demonstrated.

reviewProvenance.manualVisualComparison: Identical crouching Baba Yaga with gray unruly hair, purple headscarf, bony hands gripping a long broom and a tilted wood-stump base above branches and red mushrooms. Canonical published cover matches source views 2 and 3, which are byte-identical; other side/closeup renders corroborate the same three-dimensional sculpture.
reviewProvenance.identityProofInterpretation: Visual sculptural identity verified across available views and source/candidate image SHA-256; dHash agrees exactly but is not sufficient alone.

mediaReview.notes: Artist watermarks and third-party graphics appear across the source gallery. Two source positions contain the same SHA-256 and must not be treated as two unique media assets or copied without rights approval.

decision.nextGate: Keep only the existing published canonical model. Verify rights, author attribution and watermark policy independently before any image import, crop, replacement or publication.
